# Next.js Architecture Document References

## When to Use

- Finding the canonical document for a rule
- Deciding whether to use the AI guide or a legacy document
- Mapping implementation examples back to source docs

## Procedure

1. Read [document priority](./references/document-priority.md).
2. Read [reference map](./references/reference-map.md).
3. Use the smallest source set that answers the current question.

## Constraints

- Prefer the AI architecture guide over older narrative documents.
- Use older documents only for extra context or examples.
